notes:
Lead profile: ChorusLeaf builds a modular content generation platform for SMB ecommerce and boutique agencies. They produce daily campaign bodies, subject lines, meta descriptions, and localized landing pages. Primary pain: unit cost at scale and unpredictable latency during spikes. Technical ask: hosted API (self-serve) evaluation first — want frictionless onboarding + predictable pricing.

Volume & perf targets: expect ~200k-800k tokens/day in steady-state across many small requests (100-600 tokens each) with periodic spikes up to 1.5M tokens/day during campaign runs. Latency target for interactive route is <500ms 95p; batch background generation acceptable at 2-5s. Cost sensitivity is high — looking to compare per-token with caching + batching to current provider.

Model preferences: prefer an instruction-tuned open model (cost/latency tradeoff) and ability to fallback to smaller variants for high-throughput jobs. Interested in embeddings for search (realtime rerank + nightly reindex).

Security/compliance: SMB but handles PII in some templates; require SOC2 attestation, basic audit logs, and ability to set retention windows. No air-gapped/on-prem requirement today.

Customer quotes: "We need predictable bills at scale — spikes kill margins. If caching/batching can halve cost per generated page, we'll convert quickly."

POC goals: 1) run 7-day hosted API POC using sample campaign workload, 2) measure cost/token with and without KV/prefix cache, 3) validate latency SLOs for interactive route, 4) test embeddings qps for search rerank.

Integration notes: dev team uses Node + Python microservices; prefers SDK examples and a small quickstart repo. Wants per-route cost + token breakdown in console.

Next steps / immediate asks: send POC checklist and usage limits, attach SOC2 link to Drive, provide recommended batching config and cache TTL suggestions, confirm billing thresholds for auto-upgrade from free credits.
